audience: Describe the verified reader and the decision this article helps them make

voice.notes: Avoid jargon. Explain technical concepts with examples.

source.evidencePolicy: All material claims must link to a primary or secondary source with a retrieval date. Vendor-stated claims are acceptable with attribution.

assetPolicy.brandLogos: Use official logos from brand press kits or Brandfetch. No AI-generated logos.
assetPolicy.screenshots: Real UI captures with visible dates. No staged or mock interfaces.
assetPolicy.articleMedia: Use original or appropriately licensed educational media with provenance.

publishingApproval.notes: Confirm the actual client review process. This template grants no publication authorization.

domainReview.notes: Determine expertise and review requirements from the topic and client policy.
